UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account profile storing username, display name, optional email, and last selected private room.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the user.

username.description: Private handle shown to room members (2-24 characters).

displayName.description: Display name from Google profile or user entry.

email.description: Optional Google email address, kept private to the owner.

activePairId.description: ID of the last selected private space or group room.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

PairInvite.title: PairInvite
PairInvite.description: Private invite code lookup mapping a secret invite code to a direct (2-person) or group/family room without exposing PII or member lists.

creatorUid.description: UID of the user who created the room invite.

spaceName.description: Name of the private space or group room (1-30 characters).

roomType.description: Room mode: direct (max 2 members) or group (up to 12 members).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

PairingRoom.title: PairingRoom
PairingRoom.description: Strictly isolated private space supporting either 1-on-1 direct pairing (max 2) or private group/family rooms (up to 12 members).

ownerUid.description: UID of the person who created the room.

roomType.description: Room mode: direct (1-on-1, max 2) or group (family/group, up to 12).

maxMembers.description: Maximum allowed members in this room (2 for direct, up to 12 for group).

memberUids.description: Bounded list of 1 to maxMembers (<= 12) member UIDs.

memberNames.description: Map of member UID to private username shown inside this room (1 to 12 entries).

spaceName.description: Label for this private room (e.g., Partner, Family, Mom; 1-30 characters).

invitedEmail.description: Optional lowercased Google email of a single invited person (legacy/direct).

invitedEmails.description: Optional bounded list (<= 12) of lowercased Google emails invited to this room.

ownerUsername.description: Private username of the room creator.

partnerUsername.description: Optional private username of the joined partner (used in 1-on-1 rooms).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

StatusButton.title: StatusButton
StatusButton.description: Customizable quick-tap status button scoped strictly to one private room.

ownerUid.description: UID of the member who owns this status button.

memberUids.description: Denormalized bounded list (1-12) of room member UIDs for secure collection queries.

label.description: Short button label such as Gym, College, or Home (1-30 chars).

message.description: Custom notification message broadcast to all other members of this room (1-160 chars).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

PartnerStatus.title: PartnerStatus
PartnerStatus.description: Real-time active status document for one member, scoped strictly to one private room.

userId.description: UID of the member whose live status this represents.

memberUids.description: Denormalized bounded list (1-12) of room member UIDs.

senderName.description: Private username of the sender inside this room.

activeButtonId.description: ID of the button currently active.

buttonLabel.description: Label of the active status button.

message.description: Custom notification message attached to the active status.

iconKey.description: Icon key of the active button.

pingCount.description: Monotonically incremented counter to trigger notifications even on repeat taps.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profile and last active room preference.

/pairInvites/{inviteCode}.description: Direct-get-only secret invite code lookup documents.

/pairings/{pairId}.description: Strictly isolated private 1-on-1 and multi-member group/family rooms.

/pairings/{pairId}/buttons/{buttonId}.description: Custom status buttons isolated per private room.

/pairings/{pairId}/statuses/{userId}.description: Live active button status per member isolated per private room.
